# openai_workload_identity_providers (Data Source)

List workload identity providers, following pagination. Returns typed summaries and the raw response. Use the individual data source for full structured configuration.

Authentication: Set the admin_api_key provider attribute or OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY environment variable for the admin API audience.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openai_workload_identity_providers" "example" {
}
```
